query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      JAVA_OPTS: "-Xmx6G"
      SBT_OPTS: "-Dsbt.ci=true -Xss100M"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: '25'

      - name: Setup sbt
        uses: sbt/setup-sbt@b113b960ba361e87e08ce02a390d51871b7ee459 # v1.5.13

      - name: Cache SBT
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.m2/repository
            ~/.ivy2/cache
            ~/.cache/coursier
            ~/.sbt/launchers
            ~/.sbt/boot
            ~/.sbt/preloaded
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-sbt-${{ hashFiles('**/build.sbt', '**/plugins.sbt', '**/build.properties') }}

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e1253824e5c10ff9df46874f81ed3ec929e19cfd # v6.3.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.AWS_ROLE_PROD_GATLING }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Prepare environment
        env:
          PRIVATE_REPOSITORY_SBT: ${{ vars.PRIVATE_REPOSITORY_SBT_2 }}
        run: |
          mkdir --parents ~/.config/sbt/2 || true
          echo "$PRIVATE_REPOSITORY_SBT" > ~/.config/sbt/2/privateRepository.sbt

      - name: Test
        run: |
          sbt \
            "headerCheckAll;" \
            "scalafmtSbtCheck;" \
            "scalafmtCheckAll;" \
            "javafmtCheckAll;" \
            "scalafixAll --check;" \
            "testFull;"

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
